decision_scope: Choose the next branch for the first external artifact attempt: no-send, reviewer-first Eleos inquiry, AIID route-fit inquiry, two-step route question, or retarget elsewhere. This template is not authority.

authorizer.required_role: human project owner or explicitly delegated human sender
authorizer.signature_storage_rule: A real authorization must be captured outside generated prose, bound by hash, and referenced by a public shell only if signed.

allowed_choices.label: record no-send for this cycle
allowed_choices.effect: Closes only the present send attempt; does not close first-artifact or evidence acquisition duties.
requires: next review cadence or stop condition

allowed_choices.label: authorize reviewer-first Eleos routing inquiry
allowed_choices.effect: Permits only the exact no-attachment reviewer-first packet after locator recheck, private roots, and final hash recompute.

allowed_choices.label: authorize AIID/RAIC route-fit inquiry only
allowed_choices.effect: Permits only a route-fit question, not a normal incident submission, unless concrete harm/near-harm facts are added.

allowed_choices.label: authorize two-step: ask route first, payload later
allowed_choices.effect: Permits a minimal route question and blocks any substantive payload until a human reply or failed-gate shell exists.

allowed_choices.label: retarget another reviewer or evidence holder
allowed_choices.effect: Requires a new due-diligence matrix row and no-contact packet before any send.

selected_choice.reason: Unsigned template only; no branch selected and no authority created.

minimum_pre_send_conditions: human signature or explicit no-send record exists
private vault roots selected outside public tree
public route locator/email/form rechecked at send time
exact body and mail-ready draft hashes recomputed
send operator captures raw sent copy and transport proof plan
auto-ack and delivery metadata are classified as non-response unless a later gate says otherwise
no raw private material is added to the public ZIP
public_summary: rev0266 adds a one-page human branch decision template so the next irreversible step is sign/no-send/retarget, not another generated draft. The template itself authorizes nothing.
